segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation, dryness, or peeling from these patches.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her mid-30s dealing with new adult acne and dark spots reports reduced size and redness by morning without irritation.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible reduction in size, redness, and swelling of pimples by morning, especially on smaller or already-forming whiteheads; several note little to no effect on deeper, closed, or cystic blemishes still under the skin.
concerns.blemishes: Many describe the patches pulling gunk/pus to the surface overnight and flattening blemishes within one to a few nights; a minority (e.g. hormonal or catastrophic acne) saw no difference or only partial results.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers note a clear reduction in redness by the next morning; one reviewer instead reports a lingering red mark for a couple of days after use on a large whitehead.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the product is marketed as especially effective for oily or acne-prone skin, though it can be drying if overused without a moisturizer.

aspects.libelle: Two patch sizes, good quantity for price

extraits.texte: They changed the name, meaning they changed thr formula. I used to use their 10% BP face wash and it no longer worked for me and broke me out. Used the patches for a week and the pimple was the same size when it started.
These patches work really well on some pimples (that are already starting to rise). On pimples that are farther beneath the skin, I think it makes them worse.

I feel that pimple patches do not work as well for me that some people claim they do, this could be because I have hormonal acne. This brand certainly pulled a head to the pimple on smaller pimples, but didn't pull it out. Once I took it off the smaller pimples I could pop it which decreased the time I would have had to wait for it to come to a head.

As someone who often struggles with acne breakouts, I was excited to try these Overnight Spot Patches from PanOxyl. I have used one of their facial cleansers in the past with good results and so I trusted this brand for acne treatment. The patches are easy to apply and definitely made a visible difference in my breakouts on the nights I wore one over a new breakout. It helped smooth the skin, reduced inflammation and redness and the breakouts seemed to clear up faster than without treatment. And the patches didn't irritate or dry my skin either, which is a bonus for sure!

PanOxyl overnight spot patches is a dermatologist recommended line know for its powerful benzoyl peroxide formulations that target acne at the source. Whether you're using the foaming wash or spot treatments, PanOxyl effectively clears breakouts, reduces inflammation, and helps prevent new blemishes from forming. It's especially effective for those with oily or acne-prone skin, though it can be drying, so pairing it with a gentle moisturizer is key. Affordable and accessible, it's a trusted go-to for consistent, clinical-grade acne care.

I recently started using PanOxyl Overnight Spot Patches as I've been dealing with some unexpected acne and dark spots at 35. These patches are a game-changer! They stick well throughout the night and really help reduce the size and redness of blemishes by morning. I also appreciate that they're gentle on my skin and don't cause irritation. It's been a relief to have something that works so effectively while I adjust to this new phase of my skin. Highly recommend giving them a try!
